name: Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite
short: Google's stable high-volume multimodal model: 1M input, 65K output, $0.25/$1.50; API shutdown scheduled for 2027-05-07. No Zen route verified.
modalities: Text, image, video, audio, PDF in; text out
pricingNote: Paid standard: $0.25/M text/image/video input ($0.50/M audio), $1.50/M output; AI Studio free tier available
freeTierNote: Google AI Studio free tier only; inputs and outputs may be used to improve Google products. No OpenCode Console route verified.
standout: The low-cost bulk-processing tier: 1M context, text/image/video/audio/PDF input, and documented tool APIs.
tradeoff: The 1M window has weak 1M retrieval in GDM-MRCR v2 (12.3% pointwise); stable API shutdown is scheduled for May 7, 2027. Do not transfer preview-only Vals scores to the stable model.
